capitals.name: Dengzhi City (west of Jiuzhaigou County, Sichuan)

ledger.x: c. 424: the Baishui Qiang kingdom of Dengzhi. 'Dengzhi was first founded by Xiang Shuzhi' (Book of Zhou), undated; the first dated ruler is Xiang Qudan, c. 424-453, who 'sent horses to the Liu Song dynasty as tribute'. Confidence 1: 424 is the first dated mention, the page says only '5th century'.

wars.name: Tuyuhun attack on Dengzhi
wars.outcome: Xiang Yanheng lost power to the Tuyuhun; Western Wei troops escorted him back to his domain; the state probably ended soon after.

certainty.note: A mountain kingdom described by one line of area; no frontier on any page.
